name: SYNTHETIC Profile C - AI & Digital Transformation Consultant
summary: SYNTHETIC candidate: transformation consultant with approximately 7.3 years of experience, including 3 years delivering AI adoption and workflow automation initiatives. Combines consulting, process improvement, project delivery and change management; experience is in applied implementation, not machine-learning engineering.

professional_experience.title: Digital Transformation Consultant (Jul 2019-Oct 2023)
responsibilities: Mapped order-to-cash and service processes with client operations teams; documented current-state workflows, pain points and prioritized improvement opportunities.
Managed delivery plans, risks and stakeholder workshops for process redesign and system rollout; prepared training and change materials for affected teams.
Supported a redesigned approval workflow pilot that reduced manual handoffs by 18% against the documented baseline across two participating teams.

professional_experience.title: AI Transformation Consultant (Nov 2023-present)
responsibilities: Led discovery, use-case prioritization and change planning for AI adoption in service-desk and finance workflows; coordinated business owners, IT and risk stakeholders.

Built small Python scripts and REST API connections to integrate a hosted generative-AI service with approved ticketing and knowledge tools; delivered prototypes and workflow documentation, not ML models.

Coordinated a six-week, human-reviewed drafting pilot; 120 anonymized test queries were assessed against agreed quality and escalation criteria, and median draft-preparation time fell 25% from the pilot baseline.
Prepared user guidance and facilitated adoption sessions; tracked feedback, limitations and follow-up improvements with client teams.
